playpause.note: Iconography is baked into the texture (looks like play/pause symbols) but it's not a distinctly modeled button, just a flat graphic.

prev.note: No distinct control found here, just a structural fin with glowing lines.

next.note: Just blank hull geometry, no control surface.

repeat.note: Looks like an intake/thruster rather than a button.

queue.note: Just hull detailing/recesses, not a distinct control.

vol.note: Knob is present but its perspective is entirely broken compared to the underlying surface, floating above the gap.

shuffle.note: Toggle switch appears to be a flat decal pasted onto the surface.

notes: The aesthetic nails the vibrant 90s/PS1 racing game color palette and low-poly spaceship concept.
However, as an interface, it almost entirely fails. The controls are either missing, baked flat into the texture, or floating in incorrect perspective.
The central 'cockpit' area seems intended as a display but is not populated with the requested visualizer or album art regions.
The volume knob and seek slider are completely detached from the geometry of the spaceship wing they are supposed to be mounted on.
improve: Ensure all controls are modeled as distinct, physical elements rather than just drawn onto the base texture.
Fix the perspective and seating of the volume knob and seek slider so they physically mount into the surface of the ship.
Populate the blank regions (visualizer, album art) in the designated display areas (presumably the cockpit window).
Replace the structural fins and thrusters with actual readable buttons for the playback controls, or clearly integrate buttons into them.
